newsitem.title: CHINA: China January crude, natural gas output rise.
newsitem.headline: China January crude, natural gas output rise.

text.p: China produced 13.61 million tonnes of crude oil in January, up 6.3 percent compared with January 1996, the State Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.
China produced 158.51 million tonnes of crude oil in 1996, a rise of 6.37 percent compared with 1995, the bureau has said.
China's natual gas output reached 1.829 billion cubic metres in January, up 24.3 percent compared with January 1996, it said.
Natural gas output totalled 19.904 billion cubic metres in 1996, up 15.74 percent compared with 1995, it has said.
